Go into the dark area in the set of trees to your left and look around; you
should find a [_COSMIC BRACELET_] behind a tree there. Once you have it, head
all the way north to the next area. Hug the right wall as you go north to be in
a small area with Meiyuan and a chest containing a [_THERA SEED_]. Check just
to the west of the other chest to find another chest, this one with a
[_STAR SWALLOW_].

Go back to the main path and examine the gate to the north. It won't open, so
start heading back south, and it'll magically open for you, allowing you
entrance. Start to go up the stairs for a quick scene, then continue north to a
fork. The path to the east is locked, so use the Save Point if you want, then
go down the western stairs, moving south and opening the chest to your west for
a [_TENT_].

Ignore the door to the west, as we can't go through it yet, and continue south
and east for another quick scene. Continue east and down the stairs here to be
back on the ground floor, but before descending the stairs to the next area,
check below the stairs to your bottom-left for a [_POCKET WATCH_]. Once you
have it, go down the stairs.

Here in the basement, you'll see a skeleton that you can examine, as well as
eight coffins, plus one to the southwest that is already open. Examine the open
one for a scene. Before going back down, go up and past the statue here,
scaling the wall as you go northeast, to a small area; search here for a chest
containing a [_LOTTERY TICKET_], then go back to the eight coffins. If you
examine the skeleton, he'll tell you:

  "Raise your voice in prayer! Pray for new writing to be turned into old!
   So long as the 8 flames remain unlit, the door to the throne will not open!
   Offer up thy prayers!"

Even though the skeleton really doesn't spell it out for you, you must pray at
each of the coffins in a certain order (which happens to be in alphabetical
order) to unlock the next door, so refer to the art below to open them:

               |          Frank = 3   |   7 = Robin           |
               |          Helen = 4   |   8 = Steven          |
               '——————————————————————'———————————————————————'

After successfully solving the puzzle, you'll hear the sound of a door being
unlocked. Make your way back upstairs and to the Save Point. At the fork here,
take the eastern path (now that the door here is unlocked) and enter. Watch a
short bit of dialogue, then try to leave. Watch the events unfold here, and
once they're finished, Keith Valentine will join your party!

  NOTE     Keith comes equipped with the [_ANTIQUE RAPIER_], a
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   [_CHAINMAIL VEST_], and a [_POCKET WATCH_] equipped by default.

Unless you'd like to fight some more and get used to Keith's Ring, leave the
Blue Castle. Save on the World Map, then enter Bistritz once again.
